role: immutable research market data only; native runtime owner selects actual parents/side/quantity
universe: all completed UTC H4 bars from normalized execution-minute history, no archived parent/position/equity/outcome filtering
row_order: decision_ns increasing unique; runner filters decision_ns < actual prefix_end
decimal_fields: UTF-8 decimal strings; unavailable empty with corresponding validity0, never zero-fill missing features

causality.available_ns: decision_ns=t after completed-bar data only; actual native callback ordering determined by runtime owner
causality.D1: 30 paired SIMPLE returns, ending latest paired dailyclose c<=t-24h; sample covariance/variance ddof1; finite beta/rho/sigmas positive for risk_coefficients_valid
causality.ATR: SOL H4 true ranges; firstTR=high-low; subsequent max(high-low,abs(high-prevclose),abs(low-prevclose)); seed first14TR arithmetic mean thenWilder1/14; no prebenchmarkH4 fabricated fromdaily
causality.B2: At t-4h favorable close beyond its preceding6H4range; current close back inside SAME boundary and adverse currentH4return. Long uses preceding-high K, short preceding-low K. Raw pattern flags independent of ATR availability; do not suppress unhedgeable risk by invalid ATR.
causality.F0: A_side using BTCclose(t)/BTCclose(t-4h)-1; s*(gS-beta*gB)>0, g=laststrictlypriorpublishedrate/hoursbetweenlasttwo; last timestamps<t; requires valid coefficient/funding history. Record actual current H4 rawopen as O, not substitute previousclose for it.
causality.invalid_features: retain validity flags separately; runtime must handle unknown/unhedgeable according approved failclosed contract, not classify absent data safe
causality.no_execution_fields: No Qref, BTCparentIDs, archived calendars, capital, futureflat, futurefunding or candidateoutcomes allowed

verification: allH4 rows/order/price aggregates/source hashes; direct sample or independent full D1/beta/ATR/B2/F0 clock checks; compare overlapping discovery feature flags without importing its native baseline/parents; prefix-invariance on truncated inputs; future rows not features
ownership: broad_data_clock writes research data/builder only; native_paired_owner alone writes VPS runtime/dataclass/consumer/domain/engine/journal
limits: No economic replay/engine/training/strategy simulation; no source mutation; native API and event scheduling remain runtime-owner launch proof
